scripts.build:ordered: pnpm --filter @schnick371/devsteps-shared run build && pnpm --filter @schnick371/devsteps-cli run build && pnpm --filter @schnick371/devsteps-mcp-server run build && pnpm --filter devsteps run build
scripts.package:mcp: mkdir -p dist/mcp && cd packages/mcp-server && pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../dist/mcp
scripts.package:extension: mkdir -p dist/extension && cd packages/extension && pnpm run package && mv *.vsix ../../dist/extension/
scripts.package:extension:next: mkdir -p dist/extension && cd packages/extension && pnpm run package:next && mv *prerelease.vsix ../../dist/extension/ 2>/dev/null; mv *.vsix ../../dist/extension/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.package:all: pnpm run build:ordered && pnpm run package:mcp && pnpm run package:extension && mkdir -p dist && cp INSTALL.md dist/ && cp README.md dist/ && echo '✅ Distribution packages ready in dist/'
